title: test(app-shell): fold the other five Interfaces rail label pins onto the shared railLabels harness
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi93kH3NmKTNuUFhcMmaWEDak)_
Part of #25911

Slice 1b of #25911, the follow-up to #26255. The other five Interfaces-rail label pins (`interfacesRailLabelMap-11158`, `interfacesAppLabelMap-11181`, `railServedLabels-12688`, `zhPillarNames-11801`, `navEntryIdentity-11774`) render the real `InterfacesPillar` over the same three mocks as the five folded in #26255. They now join `StudioDesignSurface.railLabels.test.tsx`. Each former file is a top-level `describe` named after it, and each block installs its own metadata-client double into the shared `vi.hoisted` slot in a `beforeEach`. No test is deleted, and every assertion moves verbatim. The diff is test-only: no `src` file, no sdui record, no changeset.

## Before / after (same command, same box, `--maxWorkers=2`, shared-box seconds)

`pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface --maxWorkers=2` from `ui/`, with a throwaway reporter reading each module's diagnostics. Fixed cost = environment + prepare + setup + import.

| | files | tests | fixed CPU | test CPU | total CPU | wall |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| before #26255 (f143cd88) | 95 | 656 | 678.3 s | 343.4 s | 1021.7 s | 528.4 s |
| after #26255 (76d53f205) | 91 | 656 | 644.9 s | 334.9 s | 979.8 s | 507.0 s |
| after this PR (f62241cf7) | 86 | 656 | 616.8 s | 338.1 s | 954.9 s | 493.8 s |
| the ten pins alone, this PR | 6 → 1 | 56 → 56 | 41.4 s → 7.6 s | 7.4 s → 6.2 s | 48.8 s → 13.8 s | |

Across both slices the ten pins went from 10 files to 1, and the family's CPU went from 1021.7 s to 954.9 s (−6.5 %). Each folded file saved about 6.5 s of fixed cost, and the folded file's own fixed cost barely moved (7.3 s → 7.6 s). Test CPU moves by about ±10 s from run to run on this shared box, so the per-file rows are the clean reading.

## Issue number → describe (reviewer check: no assertion dropped)

| former file | describe in `StudioDesignSurface.railLabels.test.tsx` | `it` | `expect(` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesRailLabelMap-11158.test.tsx` | `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesRailLabelMap-11158` (objectui#11158) | 4 | 16 |
| `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesAppLabelMap-11181.test.tsx` | `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesAppLabelMap-11181` (objectui#11181) | 5 | 15 |
| `StudioDesignSurface.railServedLabels-12688.test.tsx` | `StudioDesignSurface.railServedLabels-12688` (objectui#12688) | 6 | 20 |
| `StudioDesignSurface.zhPillarNames-11801.test.tsx` | `StudioDesignSurface.zhPillarNames-11801` (objectui#11801) | 4 | 11 |
| `StudioDesignSurface.navEntryIdentity-11774.test.tsx` | `StudioDesignSurface.navEntryIdentity-11774` (objectui#11774) | 6 | 21 |

The five blocks from #26255 stay as they were. The mechanical check of the new file against the ten former files on main gives the same `it` titles, 50 of 50 as an identical sorted list, and the same `expect(` count, 153 against 153. The run reports 56 tests passed in the folded file, the same 56 the six files reported before (`it.each` rows expand).

What changed besides the indentation:
- The header now says ten pins. The import block adds what the new blocks use (`beforeAll`, `MockInstance`, `act`, `useLocation`, `AppSchema`, `useObjectTranslation`, `MetadataContextValue`, `ComponentRegistry`, `path`/`fileURLToPath`, `readDesignerPairs`, `t`, `listStudioCanvasPreviewTypes`). The `@ts-expect-error` for the untyped gate script moved with its import to the top of the file.
- Comments that named a file this PR deletes now name the block in this file.

Isolation: RTL `cleanup()` and react-i18next's global reset still run after every test. `navEntryIdentity-11774` registers an `object-view` recorder into `ComponentRegistry` in its `beforeAll`, so it is the last block in the file and no block after it can read that registration.

## Not in this PR

- **cli-bin split** (`ui/packages/cli/src/__tests__/cli-bin.test.ts`): slice 2, next.
- **date-only-zone-pins-10183**: not split, premise stale, as recorded on #26255.
- `autosaveSwitch-11232` (94 s of real debounce sleeps) is the family's next-largest lever. It is not touched.

## Verification (head f62241cf7)

- The family vitest run above: 86 files, 656 tests passed.
- `eslint` on the changed test file: 0 problems.
- `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit` in `ui/packages/app-shell`, after `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`: 0 `error TS`.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): 24 derived, 24 run, every one exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles as a derived zero. The diff is 1,896 changed lines, under the 3,000-line bar.
